title: Nova Swarm
shortDescription: A fast modern arcade score-chaser: dodge readable swarms, blast a boss every level, grab chaotic bonus cores, and restart instantly for one more run.
longDescription: Nova Swarm is a fast modern arcade score-chaser about surviving wave after wave of choreographed space nonsense. Pick your ship, dodge incoming fire, grab ridiculous bonus cores, and push through escalating enemy formations toward oversized boss encounters.

The game blends shoot-'em-up clarity with public arcade-comedy personality: readable bullets, compact wave briefings, original space-cabinet art, punchy radio callouts, local score chasing, and accessibility sliders for screen shake and player focus.
featureBullets: Arcade wave shooting with handcrafted early pacing and escalating late-game pressure.
Boss gates, victory beats, sector transitions, and score rewards.
Keyboard, gamepad, and mobile touch control support in the game runtime.
Context-aware music pools for menu, gameplay, boss, victory, and game over.
Optional story intro with replay from the menu, never blocking quick play.
Punchy radio callouts with music ducking.
Accessibility controls for screen shake and player-focus visibility.
Local score saving for quick retries and one-more-run improvement.

controllerSupportDecision.reason: Steamworks now uses Full Controller Support for Nova Swarm. The runtime has a locally validated controller-only path through menu, hangar/details, gameplay, pause/settings, game-over initials entry, highscores, and return-to-menu, and the owner has accepted the Full Controller Support claim for v1.

steamInputLayoutDecision.reason: Nova Swarm uses native XInput/gamepad input and plain text controller prompts such as A/B/X/Y/LB/RB/Start. No official Steam Input action manifest or custom recommended Steam Input layout is published for v1; that tradeoff is intentionally accepted, and store copy must not claim device-specific controller glyph polish or a custom Steam Input configuration.

steamCloudDecision.reason: Desktop build stores highscores and settings locally. Steam Cloud can be added after the Steam client package path is validated and save-file locations are finalized.

achievementsDecision.reason: The game has in-run accomplishment beats, but no Steamworks API integration is present. Do not advertise Steam achievements until implemented and tested.

localizationDecision.reason: Player-facing text has been cleaned into public English arcade copy. Additional localization is out of scope until a public English release candidate is approved.

recommended.graphics: Dedicated or modern integrated GPU with current drivers

approvalRequired: final controller QA notes for the release candidate
system requirements sanity check on a second Windows machine
